problemSignature.risk: CLI, KiCad plugin, web dashboard, and AI controller could disagree about project status

rootCause: BoardForge had manifest and dashboard helpers, but no single canonical artifact writer that produced the full product-facing run bundle from one evidence source.
fixSummary: Add a project artifact pack builder and CLI so every BoardForge run can emit manifest, dashboard data, user report, web card, KiCad action log, engine run log, and replay command together.

testsAdded: project artifact pack writes every platform surface output from one evidence source
platform artifacts CLI creates replayable dashboard and plugin action files

conditions: any BoardForge project run needs product dashboard, CLI replay, or KiCad plugin status

recipe: Build the project manifest from validation evidence.
Derive dashboard data and web card from the same manifest.
Write engine run log and KiCad plugin action log beside the project.
Write a CLI replay command so future controllers can continue without asking the user to reconstruct state.
safetyRules: do not write product artifacts into protected ESC/FC projects
do not mark manufacturing ready unless validation evidence is clean
do not fake DRC/ERC or sourcing status

before.artifactFlow: manifest/dashboard helpers existed but project output bundle was incomplete
